hooks.name: AGRILENS A: change impact after code modification
hooks.description: After a file is written, makes the agent run the AGRILENS impact analysis (areas, version increment, documentation, tests, stale comments) before finishing the task.

action.prompt: AGRILENS governance (hook A): a repository file was modified. Before you finish this task, run `python tools/governance/agl_governance.py impact` from the AGRILENS repository root and act on it: decide and apply the version increment with `agl_governance.py bump` if shipped files changed, update the named documentation in the same task, add or update the named tests, fix stale comments or configuration references, and add a complete entry to documentation/CHANGE_REGISTER.md. Report a concise change summary. Do not push, publish or trigger OTA.
